inputs.prompt: A creature designer's anatomy reference page for a video game boss called the cage bear, drawn in confident pencil with light warm brown, steel grey and turquoise washes on cream paper, like a page from a creature anatomy book, with small neat hand lettered labels. Top row, four reference studies of real animals side by side, each with its label underneath: a cave bear skull with its high domed forehead labelled "cave bear skull"; a grizzly bear on all fours showing its shoulder hump labelled "grizzly stance"; the bones of a bear's front leg and paw with long claws labelled "foreleg bones"; a bear's ribcage and breastbone labelled "ribs and breastbone". Bottom half, large: the cage bear seen from the side, drawn as a skeleton study inside a faint outline of its body: a heavy bear skeleton where some of its own bones have grown into polished steel and pushed out through the fur. Its ribs and breastbone have become a cage of steel bars on its chest with a glowing turquoise heart inside. The bones of one front leg have grown into a giant steel grappling claw with three hooked fingers, much bigger than the other front paw, so the bear leans its weight onto its other side. A steel crest grows along the top of its skull and stops above its eyes. Short labels with arrows point to the parts: "claw", "cage", "heart", "crest", "maw". Steel grown from bone, never armour bolted on. Clean, technical, believable anatomy, no scenery, no other text.
